<script lang="ts">
  import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
  import type { ToastPosition } from '$lib/varsel';
  import { VarselToaster } from '$lib/varsel';

  let {
    position = 'bottom-right',
    visibleToasts = 3,
    expand = true,
    duration = 5000,
    closeButton = true,
    pauseOnHover = true,
    offset = undefined,
    dir = 'auto',
    children
  }: {
    position?: ToastPosition;
    visibleToasts?: number;
    expand?: boolean;
    duration?: number;
    closeButton?: boolean;
    pauseOnHover?: boolean;
    offset?: number | string;
    dir?: 'ltr' | 'rtl' | 'auto';
    children?: Snippet;
  } = $props();
</script>

{@render children?.()}
<VarselToaster

  {visibleToasts}

  {duration}
  {closeButton}
